# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-12 from the 2026-11-12 Hub dump.

- 3,228,947 models tracked, 927,664 declare a base model, 960,959 parent links, 91,949 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
